candidates.vulnerabilityName: fujitsu esprimo_d556\/2_firmware Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information
candidates.shortDescription: A LogoFAIL issue was discovered in BmpDecoderDxe in Insyde InsydeH2O with kernel 5.2 before 05.28.47, 5.3 before 05.37.47, 5.4 before 05.45.47, 5.5 before 05.53.47, and 5.6 before 05.60.47 for certain Lenovo devices.
